findings.summary: The new operation keeps existing due dates unchanged after a time-zone change, but the amended due-date requirement says every open goal's due date must be recomputed in the new zone.
findings.evidence: operation.account.setTimeZone effects: [Update Account.timeZone, Keep existing due dates unchanged, Goals saved afterwards use the new zone] vs S.webapp.due: "When the owner changes time zone, every open goal's due date must be recomputed in the new zone."

findings.summary: Recomputation is required, yet the operation only writes entity.Account and the journey ends with the new zone displayed; nothing writes RelationshipGoal or Suggestion, and no step recomputes due state or cancels obsolete jobs.
findings.evidence: links: - { rel: writes, to: entity.Account } (only write); journey e1: "Settings show the new time zone"; actorGoal: "Keep due dates right after moving to another time zone"

findings.summary: The operation can fail with a stale-version conflict, but entity.Account has no version field, so that failure cannot be detected.
findings.evidence: failure: [..., Stale version returns conflict]; entity.Account fields: id, identitySubject, displayName, timeZone, notificationPreferences
